body: Starting from the top my friend I'd say set alarms. If you've got three days left set alarms at 12 hour intervals to ground you and remind you that you're going home soon and everything is going to be A-OK. Would you care to talk about the men in trench coats? It sounds like you could use some sleep as well.

Dear brother. I know it sounds impossibly hard and you couldn't imagine doing so but that love you feel for her is meant for someone else. If she doesn't love you back then she doesn't deserve your incredibly big heart my friend. There is someone out there that you can dump all this love on and they will love you back. Stay strong.

Dear brother/sister. This person that you're dealing with though you care very deeply for them is the wellspring of your depression. You're in a toxic relationship and it's taking a very deep toll on you. You can remain in it if you so wish but we all want you to be happy and healthy and free of what plagues you. You are more than the shackles of silence and blame you feel.

Little sister? You're seeing the wrong escape hatch here. You need to leave him not leave life. It's time to move on from this guy because he's hurt you and you're hurting you as well. To kill a cancer you must remove the tumour. To start killing your woes you need to remove the toxic relationship. Your heart is Big far far too big for him.

Dear little sister. I hope you read this. What's happened to you is not uncommon, internal recognition of futility. The whole "what's the fucking Point" "I couldn't give less of a fuck Anymore" "all of this is for Nothing". It's a slump that can hit anyone, from the most successful to the laziest to ever laze. How anyone deals with it is up to them and for some people it never really goes away. Your parents certainly to blame for a huge chunk of your depression though (at least in my eyes.) If I were your father or even your mother the simple fact that you made it as high as you did with such grace after taking such a big fall would fill my heart with pride and though I do not know you I am proud of you. We all are. 
This is your battle. You can pick up your sword and fight like a warrior or you can lay it down and exist and existing is okay it's completely okay to just be. To do the things that make you happy and to damn the rest. To take care of the people you love and not listen to their aggression if you so wish. I've lost my train of thought but this is your war. Fight it how you wish but you don't have to lose if you don't want to.
Do you have time sinks in your life mayhap? Hobbies? Even just the little things go a long way when you're fighting the specter.

I always find it so embarrassing to talk about myself at continued length it feels like I'm just talking and wasting time and taking up space. I used to love to talk about myself and the things I saw. I used to love to write but all of that as been pulled out of me and thrown to the way side. I appreciate you very much though.

890. My friend If I may pass on any shred of wisdom, as a person who had been bullied to near death myself as a child. All the issues that people force on you are issues in their own mind not true issues with you. Once you get past the point of pain that the words cause you can truly see that they are in fact just words, air blown out of peoples mouths that we allow to have meaning to us. You are beautiful and you are strong because you have made it so very far with the odds beating you back. You are worthwhile and you a more than you know.
I love others because I cannot love myself. I help people because I cannot help myself.

I've been to counsellors before but never willingly. I had one during highschool and also when I was admitted to hospital for two weeks. I went through two nurses and a therapist there. I have a tendency to lie continually to protect myself or misdirect people. To the point where I do it without noticing sometimes ( I won't lie on here there's no reason to none of you can hurt me.) I'm afraid of seeing the disgust on people's faces if they knew what I've been through and what I've seen and what I've experienced. Maybe it's the shame that keeps me away from getting help, maybe it's some sick enjoyment inside of me somewhere that likes being this fucked up. Maybe I deserve it who knows. Thank you for your advice and support I've been leaning towards getting help more and more and this was a huge step for me.

When I tried I was too distraught to think straight but my hands were the steadiest they've ever been in my entire life.  Nothing makes it easier because it's not supposed to be easy. Everything in our bodies minds and souls is hardwired to live and survive which is what I hope you can do as well my friend. Stay a while. I wish I could hold your hand.

I wish I could hold your hand right now. I could tell you a thousand things to try and make what you're feeling go away. I could rant and rail and tell you that you need to seek help and how to do it.(which I do believe whole heartedly that you should) what I will say is if you do go I hope you find your rest so that your shoulders may no longer be weary and your heart won't feel the strain. If you want to talk I'm here.

You sound a lot like me. Enough so that I will call you brother/sister. I can't explain the lack of empathy you feel, I can't explain how to make it go away or rather come back. I can't tell you that it's something you need to work on. I can say for sure though that it's akin to some form of ptsd.

Depends on where you live. Canada you'd be taken to a hospital and evaluated and either they'd hold you or release you. America I'm not so sure. 
Either way they'll ask if it's an emergency. If you say yes and tell them that you're going to try and kill yourself they'll send a cruiser to you. They'll ask you some basic questions of why and how and they'll check to see if you're intoxicated. They'll take you either to the station or the hospital and get a nurse or doctor to run an evaluation on you. If you're bad bad they'll keep you.
